verdict.rationale: Fellow automatically generates summaries, action items and minutes for every meeting in the background, and its webhooks push real-time events (AI note generated, action item completed) to a URL you specify. Paired with the REST API's write endpoints (append agenda, complete action items, upload recordings), a developer can build autonomous automations, but only with their own external code. missing for 10: a native, user-configurable automation/workflow builder or scheduled agent runs inside Fellow, documentation of no-code background automations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
